reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per UTC day with signups
  SELECT CAST(signup_ts AS DATE) AS signup_date, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  GROUP BY CAST(signup_ts AS DATE)
), windowed AS (
  -- one row per UTC day with signups
  SELECT signup_date, signups,
    SUM(signups) OVER (ORDER BY signup_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / 7.0 AS avg_7d
  FROM daily
)
SELECT signup_date, signups, ROUND(avg_7d, 2) AS avg_signups_7d
FROM windowed
WHERE signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'

WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per UTC day with signups
  SELECT CAST(signup_ts AS DATE) AS signup_date, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  GROUP BY CAST(signup_ts AS DATE)
)
SELECT d.signup_date, d.signups, ROUND(SUM(p.signups) / 7.0, 2) AS avg_signups_7d
FROM daily d
JOIN daily p ON p.signup_date BETWEEN d.signup_date - INTERVAL 6 DAY AND d.signup_date
WHERE d.signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
GROUP BY d.signup_date, d.signups

other_way.tradeoff: A self-join on the 6 days before adds the same signups without a frame, but it joins each day to a week of rows.

solver.query:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT CAST(timezone('UTC', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS signup_date, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  WHERE CAST(timezone('UTC', signup_ts) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(timezone('UTC', signup_ts) AS DATE)
), w AS (
  SELECT signup_date, signups,
    SUM(signups) OVER (ORDER BY signup_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS s7
  FROM daily
)
SELECT signup_date, signups, ROUND(s7 / 7.0, 2) AS avg_signups_7d
FROM w
WHERE signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
